disclaimer_text: Paid For And Authorized By Jonny Larsen For Congress
body:
View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/jonnyutah4congress/field-report-sept-10351949?e=c29ddb867a)
https://jonnyutah4congress.com/?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=551119d6f1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=551119d6f1&mc_eid=UNIQID

** Jonny’s Team Needs YOU 🫵
------------------------------------------------------------

Hi Friend,

We’re entering into the final push of election season, and with that, we’ve had some staff restructuring and exciting new additions to the team. Unfortunately, our newsletter took a break because of it, but we’re pleased to get back on track!

You may have received our text survey poll last week. We have reached statistical significance in the number and quality of responses, and we’re very encouraged by the results so far.

Replies continue to come in today.
https://jonnylarsen.com?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=551119d6f1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=551119d6f1&mc_eid=UNIQID
DONATE (https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jonnyutah?refcode=newsletter&refcode2=countdown&utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=551119d6f1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=551119d6f1&mc_eid=UNIQID)
YARD SIGNS (https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeh6veN3HXzR2B-jKKO2bOFgy4uqPabX0Xr2W3gVYNuirN6yg/viewform?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=551119d6f1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=551119d6f1&mc_eid=UNIQID)
STORE (https://store.jonnylarsen.com/?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=551119d6f1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=551119d6f1&mc_eid=UNIQID)

We absolutely need your support now. The 4th Congressional district is over 22,000 square miles. Our seat is definitely flippable, but only if we have enough donations to produce mailers, online ads, yard signs, and other promotional pieces to spread info about Jonny. A great way to show your support is to buy merch in our new online store (https://store.jonnylarsen.com/?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=551119d6f1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=551119d6f1&mc_eid=UNIQID) !

** Coming up this week 🎡
------------------------------------------------------------

** Come meet me in person
------------------------------------------------------------

Check our Facebook events page (https://www.facebook.com/jonnyutah4congress/events?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=551119d6f1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=551119d6f1&mc_eid=UNIQID) for more info!

Monday, September 7th, 10 am - 2 pm
* Labor Day Picnic (https://www.facebook.com/events/1055145310215850?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=551119d6f1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=551119d6f1&mc_eid=UNIQID) - Celebrate with free food, games, prize drawings, car show and music. Magna Copper Park, 8975 West 2600 South, Magna.

Wednesday, September 9th, 6 pm - 9 pm
* Utah County Democratic Party’s Elections 2026 Town Hall and Information Showcase. (https://www.facebook.com/events/1401321115189530?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=551119d6f1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=551119d6f1&mc_eid=UNIQID) Learn about candidates, causes and special party caucuses. Stay for an informative candidate Town Hall with Kent Udell, Candidate for US House District 3 and Jonny Larsen, Candidate for US House District 4. Provo High School, 1199 Lakeshore Dr, Provo.

Friday, September 11, 4 pm - 9 pm
* Patriotic BBQ Potluck (https://www.facebook.com/events/1623069582857290?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=551119d6f1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=551119d6f1&mc_eid=UNIQID) - Join us for a Tooele Democratic Party community BBQ Potluck. Bring a dish to share and we have the meat! Benson Grist Mill, 325 Pole Canyon Rd, Stansbury Park

Saturday, September 12th, 4 pm - 9 pm
* PatriotFest 2026 (https://www.facebook.com/events/2286569232181776?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=551119d6f1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=551119d6f1&mc_eid=UNIQID) - Herriman’s powerful community commemoration honoring the 25th Anniversary of September 11, 2001. Join us for a family-friendly day of honor, unity, and remembrance at J. Lynn Crane Park, 5373 Main St, Herriman.

** Wrap up last week 🤝
------------------------------------------------------------

** Volunteers
------------------------------------------------------------

Working for a campaign is challenging. Even more so when you are donating your time.

We need to fill some specialty roles as well as have volunteers to accompany us for events, town halls, and canvassers to phone bank and door knock. This is an ALL HANDS ON DECK request!

Send an email to Maria (mailto:volunteer@jonnyutah4congress.com?subject=Interested%20in%20volunteering%20for%20Jonny%20Larsen&body=Full%20name%2C%20phone%2C%20county%20and%20city%20you%20live%20in.%0A%0APlease%20share%20where%20you%20think%20you%20could%20best%20help%20volunteer%20for%20our%20campaign.%20No%20prior%20experience%20is%20needed%20but%20if%20you%20have%20it%2C%20please%20share!) , our volunteer coordinator, to find out more.

** NEW! Request a Yard Sign!
------------------------------------------------------------

** Plus New Fliers, Door Hangers
------------------------------------------------------------

We have brand new fliers, new door https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeh6veN3HXzR2B-jKKO2bOFgy4uqPabX0Xr2W3gVYNuirN6yg/viewformhangers,?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=551119d6f1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=551119d6f1&mc_eid=UNIQID and new yard signs (https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeh6veN3HXzR2B-jKKO2bOFgy4uqPabX0Xr2W3gVYNuirN6yg/viewform?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=551119d6f1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=551119d6f1&mc_eid=UNIQID) ! I had a unique request from a supporter and decided to print a few signs that welcome anyone who might be feeling politically homeless. We have “Republicans For” and “Independents For” yard signs in limited quantities. If you or anyone you know anyone is interested in one, invite them to one of our events above to pick one up, or fill out our new Yard Sign Request form (https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeh6veN3HXzR2B-jKKO2bOFgy4uqPabX0Xr2W3gVYNuirN6yg/viewform?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=551119d6f1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=551119d6f1&mc_eid=UNIQID) .

You can find all the canvassing events, door knocking, training, and more at the Utah Democrats mobilize page. https://www.mobilize.us/utahdemocrats/?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=551119d6f1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=551119d6f1&mc_eid=UNIQID

** Democratic BBQ at Storm Mountain Park
------------------------------------------------------------

mailto:scheduling@jonnyutah4congress.com?subject=I'd%20like%20to%20host%20a%20candidate%20Meet%20%26%20Greet%20with%20Jonny!&body=We had a great turnout last Saturday at Storm Mountain Park with the Sandy Democrats. Fellow candidates Zach Robinson (https://www.zachforcouncil.com/?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=551119d6f1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=551119d6f1&mc_eid=UNIQID) (Salt Lake County Council at large), Shana Anderson (https://www.andersonforutah.com/?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=551119d6f1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=551119d6f1&mc_eid=UNIQID) (Senate 19), Rod Moser (https://www.utahgrit.com/?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=551119d6f1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=551119d6f1&mc_eid=UNIQID) (House 45), and Sheriff Rosie Rivera (https://www.rosieforsheriff.com/?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=551119d6f1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=551119d6f1&mc_eid=UNIQID) (Salt Lake County) chatted with voters while enjoying a bbq dinner and potluck.

If you’re interested in hosting a meet and greet with Jonny, email Nancy at scheduling@jonnyutah4congress.com (mailto:scheduling@jonnyutah4congress.com?subject=I'd%20like%20to%20host%20a%20candidate%20Meet%20%26%20Greet%20with%20Jonny!&body=) .

** Meet & Greet in Sandy
------------------------------------------------------------

Big appreciation to neighbors in Sandy mailto:scheduling@jonnyutah4congress.com?subject=I'd%20like%20to%20host%20a%20candidate%20Meet%20%26%20Greet%20with%20Jonny!&body=who came out last week to meet Jonny and HD 19 candidate Shana Anderson (https://www.andersonforutah.com/?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=551119d6f1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=551119d6f1&mc_eid=UNIQID) ! We enjoyed conversations with both Democrats and Republicans who wanted to know the candidates’ positions on many different federal and local issues important to them.

If you’re interested in hosting a meet and greet with Jonny, email Nancy at scheduling@jonnyutah4congress.com (mailto:scheduling@jonnyutah4congress.com?subject=I'd%20like%20to%20host%20a%20candidate%20Meet%20%26%20Greet%20with%20Jonny!&body=) .

name: Scott Wiener
subject: Labor Day belongs to working people.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Scott WIENER FOR CONGRESS
body:
| |

Peter,

On Labor Day, we are reminded of the generations of workers who have organized, marched, and gone on strike to secure the right of all workers to bargain collectively.

That fight remains as important as ever.

The working families that keep San Francisco and California running are being squeezed by the rising costs of housing, health care, child care, you name it.

That is not sustainable. We cannot fix it without workers and the labor movement at the table. We must listen to workers, organize together, and refuse to accept an economy that prioritizes corporate profits over working people.

The work I’ve done in public service has benefited immeasurably from partnering with the labor movement.

When I authored the nation’s first local law requiring fully paid parental leave - so parents wouldn’t have to choose between bonding with a new child and paying the bills - I did it with labor at my side.

When we found a way to build housing while requiring prevailing wages on covered projects and creating pathways to apprenticeships, we did it with labor.

When we passed the law requiring timely access to mental health and addiction treatment, health care workers were the ones sounding the alarm. I stood with Kaiser mental-health clinicians on the picket line, and they worked with us to hold powerful insurance corporations accountable - because caregivers deserve dignity on the job, and patients deserve care when they need it.

None of these victories were possible without the labor movement.

This Labor Day, I thank workers and the labor movement for all you do to build our homes, care for our families, and make our economy run. I’m especially grateful to the Carpenters, Operating Engineers, UAW, NUHW, UFCW, SEIU, AFSCME, CSEA, Plasterers and Cement Masons, Sheet Metal Workers, Postal Workers, and working people across San Francisco for your partnership. I look forward to all we’ll accomplish in the future.

I’ll always stand with you.
Happy Labor Day.

Scott

clean_body: | | Peter, On Labor Day, we are reminded of the generations of workers who have organized, marched, and gone on strike to secure the right of all workers to bargain collectively. That fight remains as important as ever. The working families that keep San Francisco and California running are being squeezed by the rising costs of housing, health care, child care, you name it. That is not sustainable. We cannot fix it without workers and the labor movement at the table. We must listen to workers, organize together, and refuse to accept an economy that prioritizes corporate profits over working people. The work I’ve done in public service has benefited immeasurably from partnering with the labor movement. When I authored the nation’s first local law requiring fully paid parental leave - so parents wouldn’t have to choose between bonding with a new child and paying the bills - I did it with labor at my side. When we found a way to build housing while requiring prevailing wages on covered projects and creating pathways to apprenticeships, we did it with labor. When we passed the law requiring timely access to mental health and addiction treatment, health care workers were the ones sounding the alarm. I stood with Kaiser mental-health clinicians on the picket line, and they worked with us to hold powerful insurance corporations accountable - because caregivers deserve dignity on the job, and patients deserve care when they need it. None of these victories were possible without the labor movement. This Labor Day, I thank workers and the labor movement for all you do to build our homes, care for our families, and make our economy run. I’m especially grateful to the Carpenters, Operating Engineers, UAW, NUHW, UFCW, SEIU, AFSCME, CSEA, Plasterers and Cement Masons, Sheet Metal Workers, Postal Workers, and working people across San Francisco for your partnership. I look forward to all we’ll accomplish in the future. I’ll always stand with you. Happy Labor Day. Elon Musk has authorized at least $100 million in spending to help Republicans this fall. These aren't numbers someone made up for a fundraising email. This is money that already exists. And Republicans know exactly which races they need to win. **And I’m at the top of their list. **So when millions of dollars in attacks start running against me this fall, we can't wait until then to figure out how we'll respond. The money to answer them needs to already be sitting in our account. I know this is not the most exciting email I could send you. Elon Musk has authorized at least $100 million in spending to help Republicans this fall. These aren't numbers someone made up for a fundraising email. This is money that already exists. And Republicans know exactly which races they need to win. And I’m at the top of their list. So when millions of dollars in attacks start running against me this fall, we can't wait until then to figure out how we'll respond. name: James Carville
subject: Toss-up. That’s where we are.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
Inside Elections just moved New Hampshire to Toss-up. I’ve been warning about this race for months. Now it’s official.
Folks, it's James Carville.
Inside Elections just moved New Hampshire’s Senate race from **Tilt Democratic** to **Toss-up.**
This is the first race rater this cycle to put us in Toss-up territory. And I need you to understand what that means and how we got here.
**[🚨 Before you read another word, rush a contribution to Chris Pappas. This rating change is a five-alarm fire.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260907_5.AZQcK7&refcode=em20260907-5&t=1&akid=8763%2E582294%2EHl6KWJ)**
Let me tell you what a Toss-up rating means in plain English: The people whose entire job is to watch and analyze Senate races for a living are now saying this race could go either way.
Not probably Democratic. Not leaning our way. A coin flip.
**_And here’s what’s making me sick: This didn’t happen overnight. This race has been sliding._**
Earlier this cycle Chris Pappas was ahead. Not by a lot — this has always been a margin-of-error race — but he was ahead. Then the Republican money started hitting the airwaves. More than thirty million dollars in outside spending against us, us without enough money to fight back, and the polls started moving.
The most recent UNH Granite State Poll showed Sununu ahead for the first time this entire campaign — 45 to 43. **A five-point swing in the wrong direction.**
**And now Inside Elections has seen enough to move us to Toss-up.**
I’ve been warning about this for months. I warned you that New Hampshire was being ignored while money poured into other races. I warned you that John Sununu was a uniquely dangerous opponent with the name, the money, and a Republican machine that had decided New Hampshire was their best shot at keeping the Senate. I warned you that unanswered spending moves voters.
All of it is happening. Right now. In real time.
**[Rush a contribution to Chris Pappas today. $10, $25, whatever you can spare. Because a Toss-up rating is not a death sentence — but a race that keeps sliding in the wrong direction can become one.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260907_5.AZQcK7&refcode=em20260907-5&t=2&akid=8763%2E582294%2EHl6KWJ)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260907_5.AZQcK7&amount=5&refcode=em20260907-5&t=21&akid=8763%2E582294%2EHl6KWJ)**
Here’s what I need you to understand: Inside Elections doesn’t move a race to Toss-up for fun. They move it because the dynamics have shifted. And they’ve shifted because more than $30 million in Republican outside spending has gone largely unanswered while everyone’s eyes were on other races.
That ends now — or this race keeps moving in the wrong direction.
Chris Pappas has won the toughest district in New Hampshire four times. He knows how to reach voters across the aisle and build a coalition that wins. But he cannot fight off $30 million in Republican outside spending without grassroots supporters showing up _right now_ before this race slides any further.
**There is no path to winning back the Senate majority without holding onto New Hampshire’s Senate seat.** None. If Chris Pappas loses this seat, Democrats’ chances are dead in the water.
The race raters just told you this is a Toss-up. The polls are telling you the trend is moving the wrong way. I’m telling you the window to turn this around and win back the Senate is open — but it will not stay open.
**[Give what you can right now.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260907_5.AZQcK7&refcode=em20260907-5&t=22&akid=8763%2E582294%2EHl6KWJ)** Let’s win this damn thing and flip control of the Senate.
— James Carville

**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_cp_footer?refcode=em20260907-5&t=24&refcode2=8763_582294_Hl6KWJ&akid=8763%2E582294%2EHl6KWJ)**

**" In a rare move, Gov. Greg Abbott defends Medicaid funding for Texas"** via [The Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/ad6fe542-d052-49f1-96e9-ed2444f23718?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Terri Langford** - Texas Gov. **Greg Abbott** is doubling down on the state's fight to recover nearly $10 billion in Medicaid funding that the Trump administration is withholding from Texas hospitals.

"Texas is working with the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services to protect funding that helps hospitals serve Medicaid patients and keeps critical emergency care available," **Andrew Mahaleris** , Abbott's spokesman, said in a statement.

The statement comes two days after The Texas Tribune reported that the governor's office had stepped into a nearly year-long impasse between the Texas Health and Human Services Commission and Washington over the funding. The money helps hospitals close the gap between their Medicaid reimbursements and the actual costs they incur for treating low-income Texans. _([TX TRIB](https://substack.com/redirect/ad6fe542-d052-49f1-96e9-ed2444f23718?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" New polling on data centers shows how the issue could impact the midterms in Texas"** via [CBS News](https://substack.com/redirect/26c96314-349a-4f86-83b7-5bef48ffb1ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s**Jack Fink** - With the midterm elections approaching, new polling data shows that data centers could play an important role in competitive elections this year.

A poll released by the Texas Politics Project at the University of Texas at Austin found that a majority of Texans oppose the construction of data centers in their communities. In a sample of 1,200 voters, 30% of respondents strongly or somewhat supported the construction of data centers in their community, while 57% strongly or somewhat opposed.

The poll also found that respondents are worried about the potential impact of data centers on their water supply, energy bills, environment and quality of life. However, they did feel data centers could have a positive impact on the economy locally, statewide and nationally.

**Jim Henson** spoke with **Jack Fink** for "Eye On Politics" this week about the results and what they could mean for November. Jack Fink and Jim Henson discussed the issue of data centers, with Henson noting that the issue has become a lightning rod for discontent about the data centers themselves and their impacts on communities, as well as discontent around AI and anti-corporate feelings. Jack Fink also mentioned **Gov. Abbott** 's focus on data centers during a property tax relief rally in the Tyler area, which Fink believed was a sign that Republicans are feeling the issue from rural areas. _([CBS News](https://substack.com/redirect/26c96314-349a-4f86-83b7-5bef48ffb1ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" Texas Governor Hits the Brakes on Flock Camera Funding"** via [Governing](https://substack.com/redirect/f7bafd34-9b16-4036-b222-be318610eaed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) - Gov. **Greg Abbott** has ordered all state agencies to pause funding for Flock cameras as scrutiny over the AI-powered surveillance devices has mounted.

The order came as The Texas Tribune was preparing to publish an investigation detailing how a state agency has devoted at least $30 million to building up the state's Flock surveillance network by providing grants to local police departments.

Abbott gave the order on Aug. 26, 2026, to halt state funding for Flock cameras, his spokesman confirmed. "To the extent that cities get any funding for those cameras, most of it comes from the federal government. To the extent any funding comes from Texas agencies, those agencies are clarifying that those funds cannot be used for Flock cameras," **Andrew Mahaleris** said in a statement shared first with the Tribune. _([Governing](https://substack.com/redirect/f7bafd34-9b16-4036-b222-be318610eaed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" Texas hospitals expect to lose $27 million a day in Medicaid funding starting Tuesday"** via [The Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/cb829582-15b0-4b4c-aac5-f53c154e28f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Terri Langford** - When the state's new fiscal year begins on Tuesday, Texas hospitals expect to lose $27 million a day in additional Medicaid funding.

The shortfall is the result of a decision by the Trump administration to withhold approval from Texas for about $9.8 billion in the next year from three programs, the bulk of which affects the Comprehensive Hospital Increase Reimbursement Program (CHIRP). This program gives hospitals additional funding to cover the difference between Medicaid rate payments and the actual costs that hospitals incur to provide services to Medicaid patients. Essentially, hospitals, which often are paid less than what they can spend on Medicaid patients due to outdated payment rates set by the state, are losing out on their additional reimbursement for 2027.

Local governmental entities collect taxes from hospitals -- about $4 billion a year, according to the Texas Hospital Association -- and under CHIRP, the federal government matches those funds so that Texas hospitals can then use them to cover the actual costs of providing Medicaid services. Hospitals say those CHIRP dollars are critical and if they lose that funding, they will likely have to cut services to patients.

"It is impossible for a hospital to take a huge loss on a Medicaid side of their portfolio and not have that impact services across the board, regardless of what type of insurance a patient has," said **Sara Gonz alez**, a THA vice president of advocacy, public policy and political strategy. Four million low-income Texans are enrolled in Medicaid, most of them children. Dr. **Esmaeil Porsa** , president and CEO of Harris Health, said "The impacts would be catastrophic for Texas' safety-net healthcare system," **Robert Fries** , the chief financial officer for Children's Health in Dallas said in a statement that this type of funding is crucial for children's hospitals like Children's Medical Center. Gov. **Greg Abbott** sent a pointed letter Aug. 7 to U.S. Health Secretary **Robert F. Kennedy Jr.** in which he stated that there's nothing wrong with the way Texas hospitals' local taxes are collected. **Anna Stelter** , the THA's vice president of policy and **Carrie Kroll** , THA's senior vice president of advocacy and public policy, also commented on the issue. _([TX TRIB](https://substack.com/redirect/cb829582-15b0-4b4c-aac5-f53c154e28f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" A Texas Banking Billionaire and His Children Are Locked in a Bitter Succession Drama"** via [WSJ](https://substack.com/redirect/620e3e1a-88e4-464e-8854-876430061257?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s**Ben Glickman** - A family battle over a billionaire's fortune, from boats and a jet to Dallas Cowboys tickets, is rankling the board of a small regional bank in Texas.

Texas banking veteran **Gerald J. Ford** is ensnarled in a legal fight with some of his adult children over a large stake in Hilltop Holdings, the $2.2 billion financial-services holding company he forged.

Four of Gerald J. Ford's children--including son **Jeremy Ford** , who took over as chair from Gerald J. Ford in 2025--are suing to wrest away control of their father's more-than-26% stake in Hilltop, worth some $600 million.

The battle is over the control of Gerald J. Ford's stake in Hilltop Holdings, which is a significant portion of the company, and the outcome is still uncertain. _([WSJ](https://substack.com/redirect/620e3e1a-88e4-464e-8854-876430061257?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" UT Arlington president stepping down to return to teaching"** via [Fort Worth Star-Telegram](https://substack.com/redirect/69548115-c408-4cae-8a25-5f298a6cd22e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Maven Navarro** - University of Texas at Arlington President**Jennifer Cowley** announced Monday, Aug. 31, that she would step down from her role to teaching at the university.

Cowley was the first woman to serve as president of the university, a role she has held since 2022. The change is effective immediately.

"As I conclude my service as president, I do so with tremendous gratitude for what we have accomplished together, deep affection for this community, and great optimism for UTA's future. I will never lose sight of what a privilege it is to help shape the lives of our students," Cowley said in a statement.

UTA Chancellor **John Zerwas** said that when he learned of Cowley's decision, he felt gratitude for her commitment to stay at the university. _([FWST](https://substack.com/redirect/69548115-c408-4cae-8a25-5f298a6cd22e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" Talarico Is Out-Fundraising Paxton and Flooding the Airwaves in Texas Senate Race"** via [WSJ](https://substack.com/redirect/2f90afc2-641e-4f0f-8e15-6edf0066be8f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Maggie Severns** and **Elizabeth Findell** - Senate candidate**James Talarico** began August in Massachusetts, standing beside a swimming pool on tony Nantucket, where more than 100 curious islanders gathered in sunglasses and sports coats to see what the bright-eyed Democrat on a hot streak in Texas was all about.

The event, held at the cedar-shingled home of a former Biden administration ambassador, came as James Talarico made a private East Coast swing that included August stops in Martha's Vineyard, another Massachusetts vacation spot, and New York City, according to invitations that priced tickets between $500 and $13,500. _([WSJ](https://substack.com/redirect/2f90afc2-641e-4f0f-8e15-6edf0066be8f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" Talarico needs to cut Paxton's edge with rural Texans to win Senate race. Can he?"** via [Fort Worth Star-Telegram](https://substack.com/redirect/e948693e-d179-416a-b28c-9b0a2637cf08?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Eleanor Dearman** - In 2018, Texas' Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate sought to run a different type of campaign. For years, liberal candidates had focused on Texas' most populous areas -- cities where Democrats largely resided. It was just a matter of getting them to turn out, the theory went.

But **Beto O 'Rourke** wanted to try something new. He would famously stump in all of Texas' 254 counties in his 2018 race against Sen. **Ted Cruz** , zigzagging to communities across Texas, small and large. He lost a close race. However, in some ways, the strategy worked.

**James Talarico** , the party's nominee, needs votes from everywhere. He doesn't have to win rural Texas; that's practically impossible. But if he reduces **Ken Paxton** 's advantage in counties concerned about water and private school vouchers, irritated over energy and grocery costs and angry about data centers, he improves his odds.

"We're determined not to make those [campaign] mistakes of the past," Talarico said recently, acknowledging Texas Democrats have sometimes neglected areas beyond the cities and suburbs. "It's why we're constantly showing up in rural communities, in our small towns. Why are we speaking" to the concerns of voters there. _([FWST](https://substack.com/redirect/e948693e-d179-416a-b28c-9b0a2637cf08?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" Dark money in Texas Senate race spurs Talarico complaint to FEC against Paxton"** via [CBS News](https://substack.com/redirect/e219aab2-9dd0-44e0-9e7d-31eca656c4fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Gabe Kaminsky** - Earlier this year, a super PAC supporting Texas Republican Senate nominee Ken Paxton received four checks totaling over $1 million from an organization called Preserve Texas, Inc.

Preserve Texas is not registered as a political committee and has not filed paperwork with the Federal Election Commission that could reveal where the money came from. Instead, it is a Virginia-based nonprofit, incorporated by **John Plishka** , the treasurer for Paxton's Senate campaign, according to corporate documents filed in Virginia.

The arrangement, part of the dramatic uptick in American politics of anonymous, big-dollar giving, has now drawn a complaint from the campaign of Paxton's Democratic opponent, **James Talarico** , which accused Paxton and his treasurer of violating federal campaign finance rules. _([CBS News](https://substack.com/redirect/e219aab2-9dd0-44e0-9e7d-31eca656c4fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" Affordability crisis takes center stage in Texas races"** via [The Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/4705f605-8a00-4e06-8d77-10b72732185e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Joshua Fechter** ,**Paul Cobler** , **Dan Keemahill** , **Terri Langford** and **Kayla Guo** - In a state once considered one of the most affordable places in the country, candidates have popped up at barbershops and in voters' homes vowing to tackle a new problem for Texas: its cost-of-living woes.

"Affordability has become the defining issue of this cycle and the voters want candidates to speak on it," said **Michael Adams** , a professor and director of the Master of Public Affairs Graduate Program at Texas Southern University.

From housing to groceries and gas, Texans' regular expenses have risen considerably in the past several years. As those costs have grown, Texans have increasingly said the higher cost of living is one of the biggest problems facing the state.

In the state's marquee Senate race, Republican **Ken Paxton** has floated tax breaks for families to help pay for health care and housing costs, and more ideas. Among the proposals from state Rep. **James Talarico** , his Democratic foe from Austin: abolishing the gas tax to help Texans' transportation costs and expanding tax benefits for parents with kids. _([TX TRIB](https://substack.com/redirect/4705f605-8a00-4e06-8d77-10b72732185e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" Gina Hinojosa focuses on kitchen table issues as polls show the Texas Governor's race within five percentage points"** via [CBS News](https://substack.com/redirect/d7a755c1-19d0-4da7-9ad8-8772de1f65cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s**Jack Fink** - Statewide polls show the top concern among Texans is inflation and higher prices, and Democratic gubernatorial candidate Gina Hinojosa said her campaign reflects that.

"Everyone's done with the culture wars. Nobody has, really, the luxury to be focused on this. It's about kitchen table issues. That's what this campaign is about," she said.

A new poll released last week by the Texas Politics Project at UT Austin shows Gina Hinojosa trailing three-term Republican incumbent **Greg Abbott** by five percentage points, 45-40 percent. 10% are undecided, while 38% of Independents said they're undecided. Two months ago, the same poll had Abbott leading Hinojosa by seven percentage points. In the Real Clear Politics average of polls between June 3 and August 24, Abbott leads by 4.7 percentage points, 48.6 percent to 43.9 percent.

The finding foreshadows a key focus for lawmakers in the coming months, as Lt. Gov. **Dan Patrick** in March directed the Senate Local Government Committee , which Paul Bettencourt chairs, to assess the impact of the increased homestead exemptions with an eye toward raising them even further in the 2027 legislative session, which starts in January. Gov. **Greg Abbott** , meanwhile, has his own plan to eliminate homeowners' school taxes , leaving only businesses to foot that bill.

The Legislature last year raised the homestead exemption -- the amount a homeowner can deduct from the taxable value of their residence -- to $140,000 for most homeowners and to $200,000 for those over age 65 or with disabilities. It was the fourth time lawmakers have raised the homestead exemption since 2015, when it was just $15,000 for standard homeowners and $25,000 for seniors.

Paul Bettencourt's committee staff found that 39% of all homeowners did not pay any school property taxes following the latest hike to the homestead exemption, up from 28% in 2024. Among seniors and disabled Texans, 61% of homeowners paid no school taxes. These homeowners' school tax bills also have long been frozen at the amount they paid in the first year they qualified for either exemption. State Sen. **Molly Cook** said renters don't benefit from the higher homestead exemptions, and argued the state cannot always rely on hefty surpluses to fill in the gaps left by lost tax revenue. _([HOU CHRON](https://substack.com/redirect/46e85cf9-135f-46f1-9e85-baba98c7fe22?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" Tesla advances Austin chip facility as Musk's Texas Terafab takes shape"** via [Austin American-Statesman](https://substack.com/redirect/7cf844fc-3b08-4cc0-a384-e99e17764a5b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s**Andrea Guzm an** - "**Elon Musk** 's vision to build the world's largest chip manufacturing plant is moving ahead. Now, new state records offer fresh details about work on the Austin semiconductor facility and the timeline for the Terafab plant. Construction filings with the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation detail $150,000 in planned work across several projects at Tesla's Austin campus, including work on its semiconductor facility.

One project filing lists $50,000 in ground-up construction and an interior finish-out for what Tesla calls its "Austin semiconductor fab." Another project, dubbed "north campus manufacturing," similarly lists new construction work on Harold Green Road. On Robotic Avenue amid its sprawling Austin campus, Tesla describes new construction for Cortex 2.0, the name the company has given to its AI training supercluster.

First announced in March, SpaceX and Tesla's Terafab project aims to make chips for artificial intelligence and space data centers. In July, the rural school districts where the massive facility will be built signed off on school tax breaks for the project. Gov. ** **Greg Abbott** ** also signed off on the incentive shortly after. Now, a new filing posted by the Texas comptroller offers more about Terafab's timeline and economic impact. _([AAS](https://substack.com/redirect/7cf844fc-3b08-4cc0-a384-e99e17764a5b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" Southwest Airlines picks Austin for one of its first-ever airport lounges"** via [Austin American-Statesman](https://substack.com/redirect/86c65d55-7b2a-49d5-b6a8-00d4ff2a7605?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Alex Driggars** - Southwest Airlines will open its first-ever airport lounges next year -- and flyers at Austin-Bergstrom International Airport will be among the first to try one out.

The Dallas-based airline will initially open four lounges in Austin, Baltimore, Honolulu and Nashville, Tenn. It plans to build at least seven more in coming years "across high-demand business and leisure markets," the company said Wednesday.

Southwest is partnering with JPMorgan Chase to launch a new high-end, airline-branded credit card next year, and cardholders will be granted access to the new lounge network.

"Southwest Airlines has built one of the most trusted brands in travel by delivering authentic Hospitality that Customers value. Our lounges will be a natural extension of that experience, offering Customers a place to relax and experience the Southwest brand in a new way," **Tony Roach** said in a statement. "The introduction of a lounge network represents a strategic investment in Rapid Rewards and deepens our 30-year partnership with Chase." _([AAS](https://substack.com/redirect/86c65d55-7b2a-49d5-b6a8-00d4ff2a7605?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" State Agency Approves First 'Permian Basin Reliability Plan' Transmission Lines as Paxton Joins Opposition"** via [The Texan](https://substack.com/redirect/142d50b1-21ee-4f87-b32d-d11a874f7ffa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s**Isaiah Mitchell** - The Public Utility Commission of Texas (PUC) approved two high-voltage transmission lines proposed as part of the Permian Basin Reliability Plan last week, clearing the way for a project that's drawn fire from a coalition that now includes the state's chief legal officer.

The PUC, the state agency responsible for economic regulation of the state's electric and water utilities, voted unanimously on Friday, August 28 to amend Dallas-based electric company Oncor's certificates of convenience and necessity -- a permit that authorizes a company to provide a public service -- for two of the five 765-kilovolt (kV) transmission lines that make up the drafted Permian Basin Reliability Plan network. Oncor's lines are the first of the five to gain approval.

On the same day, **Ken Paxton** , this year's Republican nominee for U.S. Senate, called on state authorities to pause further action on the plan. "The Legislature must be afforded the time to review the Plan and its potential impacts so it can then enact additional legislation to provide whatever additional guidance it deems fit," Paxton wrote. _([THE TEXAN](https://substack.com/redirect/142d50b1-21ee-4f87-b32d-d11a874f7ffa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" Ferguson completes $1.6B acquisition of Texas valve distributor"** via [Virginia Business](https://substack.com/redirect/96284cdb-31fe-4c04-a344-929ff5ebbcd8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Josh Janney** - Ferguson Enterprises announced Tuesday that it has completed its $1.6 billion acquisition of Houston-based FloWorks from private equity firm Wynnchurch Capital.

The deal closed Monday after customary closing conditions were satisfied. FloWorks, which generated about $1 billion in revenue in 2025, is an industrial distributor and service provider of valves and flow control solutions. Ferguson previously said the acquisition is expected to create additional revenue opportunities and about $45 million in annual cost savings.

"We are pleased to officially welcome the FloWorks team to Ferguson," Ferguson CEO **Kevin Murphy** said in a statement. "Together, we strengthen our ability to serve customers across the non-residential market by combining our national scale and distribution expertise with FloWorks' deep technical capabilities in valves, automation, rotating equipment and fluid handling." _([Virginia Business](https://substack.com/redirect/96284cdb-31fe-4c04-a344-929ff5ebbcd8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_
